# JOURNAL — <project> · <cycle name>

Terse reflection entries, written DURING the run
at its reflection points — never a retrospective.
Kept in the cycle folder; at the project-workspace
level its home is outer/ (process intel, never
the public core — flagged entries cross inward
only by named act at submission time, under the
two-shell law).

## Entry shape

One block per entry, newest last:

```
- <date> · <seat> · **<beat word: Started /
  Gap / Issue / Evolution / Harvest>:** <what
  happened · the gap or issue · how it evolved —
  terse, in the run's own words>
  `submission: <what the submission harvest
  should consider>` (only when flagged)
```

## Reflection points (required)

- **On receiving the stick** — the wave lead's
  first entry: where the wave starts, as received.
- **On returning the stick** — the wave lead's
  entry with the return: what the run taught that
  the records don't say.
- **At cycle close** — the harvest entry: where
  it started → where it landed. A cycle does not
  close without it.
